previous.text: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

next.text: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
